primary_endpoint.definition: Normalized substitutions, deletions, and insertions divided by every frozen reference word; every failed case remains a full-reference deletion.

exact_concept.definition: Multiset precision, recall, omissions, insertions, and per-category counts over exact concept signatures: category, concept, subject, assertion, temporality, plus any frozen flat slots. Evidence coordinates and annotation IDs are provenance and do not affect matching.

impact_weighted_concept.definition: Exact concept omissions and insertions are multiplied by externally supplied positive finite impact weights keyed by canonical exact concept signature. Weighted error rate is (weighted omissions + weighted insertions) / total expected weight; it is a cost ratio and may exceed one. Weighted precision and recall use matched, observed, and expected weight respectively.
impact_weighted_concept.weight_source: independently reviewed and adjudicated annotation input; no default weights are assigned
impact_weighted_concept.weight_provenance: canonical JSON of the complete concept-weight mapping is SHA-256 bound in every metric result
impact_weighted_concept.missing_weight_policy: fail closed if any expected or observed exact concept signature has no supplied weight

requirements: two distinct reviewer identities and hash-bound adjudication for disagreements
clinical vocabulary and flat extra slots frozen before annotation

prohibitions: WER is never modified by a secondary metric.
ASR predictions, model consensus, or synthetic fixtures are not clinical gold.
Automated metric output does not establish clinical validity or release readiness.
